question: What scholarly and temporal knowledge is attained within three years as a result of the practice?
premises: One becomes lord of the four Vedas.
One becomes a knower of the three times.
This attainment occurs within three years.
inference: The practice promises complete Vedic mastery and knowledge of past, present, and future in three years.
plain_english: Having become lord of the four Vedas and knower of the three times within three years.
